SYLLABUSES FOR THE DEGREE OF BACHELOR OF JOURNALISM (constructed test document, fictional)
Language Enhancement Courses (6 credits)
CAES1001. Academic Communication in English* -
* Students who have achieved Level 5 or above are exempted from taking this non-credit course.
CSSC9001. Practical Chinese for Social Sciences Students or (6 credits)
CUND9001. Basic Spoken Cantonese for Mandarin Speakers
(for Putonghua-speaking students) or
CUND9002. Practical Chinese and Hong Kong society (for Putonghua-
speaking students)
Candidates who did not study Chinese may take one of the following courses in lieu:
CHIN9501. Chinese as a Foreign Language I
Core courses (12 credits)
Candidates are required to take the following core courses:
JMSC1001. Principles of journalism (6 credits) 1 or 2
JMSC1011. Reporting and writing (6 credits) 1 or 2
Disciplinary Elective Courses (12 credits)
JMSC2005. Photojournalism (6 credits)
JMSC2008. Media and society (6 credits)
JMSC1001. Principles of journalism (6 credits)
An introduction to journalism and the news media. Assessment: 60% coursework, 40% examination.
JMSC2005. Photojournalism (6 credits)
Prerequisite: JMSC1011
Assessment: 100% coursework.
